מודל בייסיאני היררכי: התמיכה בכל מפלגה ה: Hierarchical Bayesian model: each party's support is a time series that drifts at a rate learned from the data, separately per party - capped at roughly 10% relative change per week, so a one-off jump (a new list entering) is not projected forward as permanent volatility. Each pollster gets a learned house effect - its systematic lean relative to the rest - which is netted out. Every poll is weighted by sample size, and extra noise is learned per pollster. The output is not a single number but thousands of possible election-day scenarios
שני הפספוסים - ש\"ס (8 במודל, 11 בפועל): The two misses - Shas (8 in the model, 11 actual) and Meretz (5, and actually below the threshold) - were an industry-wide error: every pollster missed them. What the polls know, the model extracts precisely; what they do not know, it can only bring in from outside and give a range - which is exactly the job of this year's 2022 calibration. And on election eve 2022 the model gave the Netanyahu bloc a 68% chance of a majority, not 95% - the gap between 60 and 64 sat inside the stated uncertainty
כל סקר בחירות שפורסם לציבור חייב, לפי סע: Every election poll published to the public must, under Section 16E of the Election Propaganda Law, be filed with the Central Elections Committee and is published on its website. Project 120 reads all polls from there - as filed, including sample size, fieldwork dates and method - not from news sites. Sub-population polls, polls without a vote question and duplicate filings are excluded
כל תסריט של חלקי קולות מומר ל-120 מנדטים: Every vote-share scenario is converted to 120 seats by the Bader-Ofer method: 3.25% electoral threshold, quota, surplus allocation by largest average, and surplus agreements between lists. The method was validated against the 25th Knesset election results and reproduces them exactly. The model knows nothing about turnout, events that have not yet happened, or who will form a government
עד כמה המודל מדויק? הרצנו אותו, ללא שינו: How accurate is the model?
